_comment: Declared PII per database: table -> column -> PII type. The strongest classification signal; column-name heuristics, value sampling and NER only fill in for columns not listed here. Types: PERSON, EMAIL, PHONE, NIC, CREDIT_CARD, IBAN, IP_ADDRESS, ADDRESS, DATE_OF_BIRTH, SECRET. Use NONE for text columns reviewed as not personal data: NER then skips them (regex checks still run), which avoids false positives such as the city 'Kandy' being read as a name.
